login.title: Sign in to Navo
login.subtitle: Track contracts, purchase orders and deliveries.

overview.introClear: Nothing needs attention. Everything is on track.
overview.noUpcoming: No deliveries planned in the next 7 days.
overview.adminIntro: The Admin role does not include business reports or receivables.

contracts.title: Contracts
contracts.searchPlaceholder: Contract no., title, customer, customer ref…
contracts.emptyHint: Create the first contract to start tracking.
contracts.noLinesHint: Good — every line is on track.

contract.activateHint: The contract gets its official number (SC-year signed-sequence) and can be used for purchase orders and deliveries.
contract.draftBanner: Draft contract — not counted in figures yet. Activate it once the customer has signed.
contract.legend: Progress bar: dark blue is delivered, light blue is received but not yet delivered. Click a line for details.

next.no_plan: Line {{line}} · {{name}}: {{remaining}} {{unit}} have no delivery plan ({{available}} available now).
next.stock_short: Line {{line}} · {{name}}: the {{date}} delivery needs {{needed}}, only {{available}} {{unit}} available.
next.receipt_overdue: Line {{line}} · {{name}}: goods are late against the expected date. Check with the supplier.
next.under_ordered: Line {{line}} · {{name}}: {{missing}} {{unit}} not yet ordered from a supplier.
next.over_ordered: Line {{line}} · {{name}}: ordered {{over}} {{unit}} more than the contract.
next.over_delivered: Line {{line}} · {{name}}: delivered {{over}} {{unit}} more than the contract.

docs.unitPriceHidden: Purchase prices are shown only to people allowed to see them.

po.title: New purchase order from contract
po.pickHint: Quantities still to order are filled in.
po.etaHint: Enter it so Navo can flag late goods.
po.overWarning: {{over}} {{unit}} over the contract. You can save a draft; confirming needs Admin approval.
po.after: Once confirmed, the lines' ordered quantities increase and the PO can no longer be edited directly.

gr.title: Record goods received · {{number}}
gr.hint: Only accepted goods count as received; rejected goods are tracked separately.

do.consequence: Once confirmed, line {{line}} delivered goes up by {{qty}} {{unit}}. It cannot be edited directly; corrections need a reversal with a reason.

newContract.title: New contract
newContract.subtitle: Saved as a draft; activate it once the customer has signed.
newContract.nameHint: Leave empty to use the catalogue name.
newContract.noCustomers: No customers yet. Add a customer first.

partners.title: Customers & suppliers
partners.codeHint: 2–12 capital letters or digits, e.g. STRA.
partners.name: Name

users.title: Users & permissions
users.name: Full name
users.passwordHint: 10–72 characters. The user should change it after first sign-in.
users.adminNote: Administrators have all permissions and can view all company records.
users.resetHint: Set a temporary password, tell the person directly, and remind them to change it after signing in. All their current sessions end.
users.resetDone: Password reset for {{name}}. Tell them the temporary password.
users.deactivateHint: Untick when someone leaves: they are signed out at once and the data they created stays.
users.selfHint: You cannot deactivate yourself or remove your own Admin role.
users.rolesHint: A person can hold several roles. Roles decide the menu and the data they see.
users.scopeHint: Whose customers, contracts and orders this person sees (from their roles).
users.grantsHint: Additional permissions supplement the selected roles. Permissions included in a role remain enabled.
users.grantNotYours: Only someone who holds this permission can give it to others.

grantDesc.purchase_cost_read: Sees supplier unit prices on purchase orders and exports.
grantDesc.finance_read: Sees receivables, payables, money received and unallocated.
grantDesc.fulfillment_confirm: Moves receipts and deliveries from draft to confirmed (counted in figures).
grantDesc.quantity_override: Approves ordering or delivering over the contract. Sees quantities and reasons, never purchase prices.

users.unsaved: Unsaved changes. The person sees the new menu the next time a page loads.

errors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.

network.offline: Cannot reach the server. Check your connection and try again.
network.timeout: The server took too long. Please try again.

codes.auth_unauthorized: Your session has ended. Please sign in again.
codes.auth_forbidden: You do not have permission to do this.
codes.resource_not_found: Not found, or you do not have access.
codes.resource_conflict: Someone else just changed this. Reload and try again.
codes.rate_limited: Too many attempts. Please wait a moment.

reasons.contract_not_draft: Only a draft contract can be activated.
reasons.contract_not_active: Activate the contract before ordering or delivering.
reasons.quantity_exceeds_contract: Line {{line_no}}: over the contract (contract {{contract_quantity}}, ordered {{already_ordered}}, adding {{requested}}). The PO stays a draft; Admin approval is needed.
reasons.receipt_exceeds_ordered: Line {{line_no}}: accepted goods exceed the quantity ordered (ordered {{ordered}}, already received {{already_received}}).
reasons.insufficient_stock: Line {{line_no}}: not enough goods (available {{available}}, needed {{requested}}). Record goods received first.
reasons.purchase_order_not_confirmed: Confirm the purchase order before recording goods.
reasons.idempotency_payload_mismatch: This action was already sent with different details. Close and reopen to refresh.
reasons.assign_owner: You can only create contracts for yourself.
reasons.idempotency_authorization_changed: Your permissions or assignments changed. Reload the document to check the saved outcome.
reasons.version_conflict: This record changed. Reload it before saving your changes.
reasons.reversal_has_dependents: Correct the dependent documents or allocations first.
reasons.document_not_confirmed: Only confirmed documents can be reversed.
reasons.document_not_posted: Only posted cash documents can be reversed.
reasons.invoice_has_payments: Reverse the linked payment allocations before cancelling this invoice.
reasons.acceptance_requires_delivery: Acceptance requires full delivery on or before the acceptance date.
reasons.milestone_already_triggered: An event is already recorded. Correct it before entering a new event.
reasons.nothing_to_close: There is no outstanding quantity to cancel.
reasons.legacy_export_unavailable: This older batch has no frozen file. Use the originally downloaded workbook.
reasons.export_amount_precision: An amount is too large for a reliable Excel currency export.
reasons.archive_too_large: This archive exceeds 500 MB. Download individual documents.
reasons.ai_daily_limit: You reached your daily document-reading limit.
reasons.files.write: You do not have permission to change document files.

validation.decimal: Enter a number with at most {{max_scale}} decimals.
validation.one_of: Please choose a value from the list.
validation.taken: This value is already in use.
validation.not_in_contract: This line is not part of the contract.
validation.not_customer: This partner is not a customer.
validation.not_supplier: This partner is not a supplier.
validation.tax_code: A tax code has 10 digits (or 10 digits-3 digits).
validation.required_when_firm: Choose a date when the plan is firm.

mobile.offline: No connection. Showing figures from {{time}}; they may be out of date.
mobile.offlineNoData: No connection. Pull down to retry when online.
mobile.poMeaning: A purchase order is sent to a supplier.
mobile.doMeaning: A delivery is one shipment to the customer.
mobile.webOnly: Creating and confirming documents is done on the web.

attn.receipt_overdue: Goods have not arrived by the expected date.

mobile.noTasks: Nothing to do. Follow-ups from your notes show here.
mobile.noArriving: No goods due in the next 7 days.

note.title: Customer meeting note
note.bodyPlaceholder: What the customer said, needs, promised…
note.voiceHint: Tap "Speak", then the microphone on the keyboard. Say something like "Huy needs a quote for 6 DN80 valves before 20/11, remind me Friday".
note.needTask: Enter what to do for the reminder date.

saved.title: Saved on this phone
saved.text: The note is on the phone and not sent yet.

offline.title: No connection — saved on this phone
offline.text: Navo sends it when you are online. You can close this screen.

sent.title: Sent
sent.text: The note and next step are in Navo.

recovery.attachmentPending: The draft and payment terms are saved. Retry to attach the source file.
recovery.finishPending: Finish the pending receipt before changing its contents.
recovery.handoverHint: Select the contracts and open tasks to transfer. Historical authors remain unchanged.
